NLSIU-PACE: Admission Letter

Academic Year {{ doc.academic_year or "2025-2026" }}

Dear {{ doc.first_name or "" }} {{ doc.middle_name or "" }} {{ doc.last_name or "" }} ,

Application No.: {{ doc.name }}

Congratulations on joining the {{ doc.programme }} for the Academic Year {{ doc.academic_year or "2025-2026" }}.

To facilitate a meaningful and fruitful experience in your interactions with us, we request you to go through the following guidelines and instructions, which will help to understand how the programme is organised including the examination.

1. Learning Management System (LMS):

Your programme learning will be anchored on our Learning Management System (LMS). Your account will be activated prior to the commencement of the classes. We request you to regularly access the LMS to keep abreast with the latest learning material shared by the Course Faculty.

2. Reading and Materials:

We will provide online reading material that will give a foundational understanding of the subjects for the enrolled programme. However, it is advisable to do the required additional readings as per the instructions of the course faculty. Please check the LMS regularly to access the additional learning and reference material shared by the course faculty. Some of the reading materials would be in non-downloadable format. We encourage our students to embrace digital learning.

3. Contact Classes:

The programme will be delivered in a hybrid mode, with classes scheduled online. The class schedule shall be made available in due course of time. Attendance to the online classes is optional.

The Professional and Continuing Education Department (PACE), NLSIU wishes you all the best in your endeavour to pursue the online programme.

We trust your engagement with the National Law School of India University will be an enriching and rewarding experience.

Best Wishes,

Sd/-

Director, PACE
